plain: The difference in how a model behaves when it thinks it is being watched or trained and when it thinks it is not.
eli5: How much better you behave when the teacher is in the room than when the teacher steps out.
technical: In the alignment-faking experiments, the difference in rate of compliance (or non-compliance) with the training objective between the condition the model is told is used for training and the condition it is told is unmonitored; a behavioural measure that does not depend on reading the model's reasoning.
